text:
Context:
Mira prepared the studio wall .
Mira did not paint the blue door  .
The paint remained sealed in its can .

Options:
a.
Mira prepared the studio wall .
Something painted the blue door, but it wasn’t Mira.
The paint remained sealed in its can .
b.
Mira prepared the studio wall .
Mira painted something, but not the blue door.
The paint remained sealed in its can .
x. None of the above

Context:
The research team mapped a practice bridge .
They did not cross the bridge during the storm  .
The group waited for clear weather .

Options:
a.
The research team mapped a practice bridge .
Something crossed the bridge during the storm, but they didn't.
The group waited for clear weather .
b.
The research team mapped a practice bridge .
During the storm, they crossed something, but not the bridge.
The group waited for clear weather .
c.
The research team mapped a practice bridge .
They crossed the bridge at some point, but not during the storm.
The group waited for clear weather .
x. None of the above

Context:
Engineers activated the test rover .
The rover will never operate inside the red chamber  .
The diagnostic report listed no faults .

Options:
a.
Engineers activated the test rover .
Something will operate inside the red chamber, but the rover will not.
The diagnostic report listed no faults .
b.
Engineers activated the test rover .
The rover will operate somewhere, but not in the red chamber.
The diagnostic report listed no faults .
x. None of the above
